verdict.rationale: Gram's evidence covers MCP server hosting, toolset governance, OAuth, RBAC, and 'skills' loaded on demand, but none of it describes a runtime meta-tool (e.g., search_tools/load_tool) mechanism that lets an agent dynamically discover and load individual tool definitions instead of receiving a large static toolset. The closest analog (SKILL.md manifests loaded on demand) is a different mechanism from runtime tool search across a large tool catalog.
